settings.q: When will my order ship?
settings.a: You get an email with tracking as soon as your order ships. Delivery estimates show at checkout.

settings.q: How much is shipping?
settings.a: Subscriptions ship free. One-time orders of 2 or more packs ship free too. Smaller one-time orders show the shipping cost at checkout.

settings.q: Can I change or cancel an order?
settings.a: Write to us as soon as you can. If it has not shipped yet, we will do our best to change it.

settings.q: Is there a limit per order?
settings.a: Up to 24 packs per order. Need more for a team, a gym or a store? Write to us.

settings.q: How do subscriptions work?
settings.a: Pick your packs and organic flavors, then Monthly or Every 3 months. Every 3 months ships a 90 day supply in one box at 20% off. Every subscription ships free.

settings.q: How do I skip or cancel?
settings.a: Log in to your account and open your subscription. Skip, swap, change quantity or cancel before your next billing date. No phone call.

settings.q: Can I swap organic flavors or formulas?
settings.a: Yes. Swap between Organic Salty Orange and Organic Salty Watermelon, or between Everyday and Energy, in your account before your next billing date.

settings.q: Can I change how often it ships?
settings.a: Yes. Switch between Monthly and Every 3 months in your account.

settings.q: How do I get Free Creatine?
settings.a: Subscribe to 3 or more packs, any mix of Everyday and Energy, in any organic flavor. A pouch of creatine is added to your box free with every delivery: Free Creatine For Life of Subscription.

settings.q: What if I drop below 3 packs?
settings.a: The free pouch comes off your box until your subscription is back at 3 or more packs.

settings.q: Can I get a second pouch?
settings.a: On Every 3 months, you can add a 2nd pouch at 50% off in your cart, so your creatine lasts the full 90 days.

settings.q: Can I buy creatine on its own?
settings.a: Yes, one-time, on the Creatine page.

settings.q: What is the difference between Energy and Everyday?
settings.a: Both share the same electrolyte base and 1,200mg sodium. Energy adds 150mg natural caffeine from coffee bean. Everyday is caffeine-free and adds Vitamin D3 and Vitamin K2. See every ingredient.

settings.q: How do I mix it?
settings.a: One stick into cold water. Shake until it dissolves.

settings.q: What is it sweetened with?
settings.a: Monk fruit extract and Reb M (as OnoSweet). 0g sugar per stick pack.

settings.q: Is it right for me?
settings.a: As printed on the pack: consult your healthcare professional before use if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication or have a medical condition. Energy contains caffeine.

settings.q: What is the 45 day promise?
settings.a: If Fortified is not for you, contact us within 45 days of delivery and we will refund the purchase price. No return required: keep, share or discard it. Requests after 45 days from the delivery date cannot be honored.

settings.q: How do I ask for a refund?
settings.a: Email hello@livefortified.com with your order number and a short note. Refunds go back to your original payment method within 5 to 10 business days after approval; bank posting times vary.

settings.q: Does a refund cancel my subscription?
settings.a: No. A refund on a subscription order does not cancel future deliveries. Cancel in your account before your next billing date.

settings.q: I bought it from another store.
settings.a: The 45 day promise covers orders placed on livefortified.com. Purchases from a marketplace or another retailer follow that retailer’s return policy.

settings.q: My order arrived damaged or defective.
settings.a: Contact us right away at hello@livefortified.com and we will replace it at no cost or refund you. Read the full refund policy.
